document: IStructE/Concrete Society SMDS Chapters 1–5 — Diagram Analysis

diagrams.caption: Internal beam/column intersection showing flexible detailing of reinforcement

elements_visible.column_bars: straight through junction (vertical, continuous through beam depth zone)
elements_visible.top_support_bars_primary: horizontal, at top of primary beam, placed ABOVE secondary beam bars
elements_visible.top_support_bars_secondary: horizontal, at top of secondary beam, below primary beam top bars
elements_visible.bottom_span_bars: horizontal in bottom zone of beam spans, STOPPING SHORT of column faces (both primary and secondary)
elements_visible.link_hanger_bars: L-shaped or straight, stopping short of column face
elements_visible.links_stirrups: closed rectangular links visible on beam spans
elements_visible.bottom_support_bars: separate bars at column zone providing bottom continuity

key_spatial_relationships: Bottom span bars terminate at column face — do not enter column
Link hanger bars terminate at column face
Column bars are vertical and continuous
Support bars at top are layered: primary above secondary
Separate bottom support bars provide continuity through column zone
DXF_primitives_needed: LINE (bar representations in 3D, simplified to 2D for plan/elevation)

diagrams.caption: Elevation of reinforcement at beam/column intersection

elements_visible.column_above: column reinforcement from above, cranked inside at 1:10 ratio with 50mm offset at kicker level
elements_visible.kicker: small concrete kicker visible at base of upper column
elements_visible.lap_zone: compression or tension lap depending on design — shown on column as vertical zone
elements_visible.beam_bars: horizontal bars at both top and bottom of beam cross-section
elements_visible.beam_links: closed rectangular links at regular spacing
elements_visible.slab_reinforcement_zone: space must be checked for slab bars at correct cover
elements_visible.cross_ties: at 1000mm centres to limit link free height to 400mm
elements_visible.vibrator_holes: holes in formwork; 75mm per 300mm beam width

notes_from_figure: Column bars cranked inside at Crank 1:10
Check column bars when cranked do not foul other reinforcement
Compression or tension lap depending on design
Hole for vibrator: allow 75mm space for every 300mm of beam width
Check sufficient space for slab reinforcement at correct cover
Cross ties at 1000 crs to limit free height of link to 400mm
Check concrete cover is maintained to link
Check if chamfers and fillets required (they may affect cover to reinforcement)
See note 3 (secondary beam increased cover — lever arm check)

DXF_reconstruction.concrete_outline: POLYLINE — rectangular beam section + column above and below
DXF_reconstruction.column_bars_elevation: LINE — vertical, cranked with 1:10 slope, offset 50mm
DXF_reconstruction.beam_bars: LINE — horizontal at top and bottom covers
DXF_reconstruction.links: POLYLINE — closed rectangle at each link position
DXF_reconstruction.cross_ties: LINE — short horizontal at 1000mm vertical spacing

diagrams.status: DIRECTLY STATED (notes from figure) + INFERRED (geometry from visual)

diagrams.caption: Detail of beam corner

elements_visible.main_beam_bars: large circular cross-sections (3–4 bars shown) within link
elements_visible.link: closed rectangular stirrup encompassing main bars
elements_visible.corner_condition: if corner bar must move to the right due to link radius, use smaller diameter — check with Designer

key_rules_illustrated: Standard radius for both links and secondary beam reinforcement must pass between main reinforcement
If displaced, main bar must not foul any other bar
Corner bar must fit into radius of link; if not, use smaller diameter — check with Designer

diagrams.caption: Plan of reinforcement at beam/column intersection
diagrams.type: Plan view (horizontal cross-section at beam level)

elements_visible.column_section: large square cross-section with column bars shown as filled circles (bars from below)
elements_visible.beam_links: rectangular closed links extending either side of column section
elements_visible.returned_legs_of_link: visible at column zone — contribute to actual clear space
elements_visible.beam_bars: circular cross-sections in rows within links
elements_visible.cross_bar_arrangement: X-pattern bars in column zone connecting different beam directions
elements_visible.central_area_large_column: advisable to keep free of links for formwork cleaning access

key_rules_illustrated: Check sufficient space between links for concrete and vibrator to pass
Add returned leg thickness to get actual clear space between links
Returned legs of link are NOT the same as the link body
With large columns, keep central area free of links for formwork access
Chamfers if required affect cover to reinforcement
Column bars from below = filled circle symbol

symbol_conventions.bar_cross_section_in_beam: hollow circle or filled circle depending on convention

diagrams.caption: External beam/column intersection showing flexible detailing of reinforcement

elements_visible.u_bars: U-shaped bars inserted into column, angled towards far face
elements_visible.beam_cage: prefabricated cage being placed from side

key_rules_illustrated: U-bars go into column reinforcement before prefabricated beam cage placed
U-bars must be as close to far face of column as possible
Construction sequence: lower column cast → U-bars inserted → beam cage placed
diagrams.status: INFERRED from visual + DIRECTLY STATED (caption and text)

diagrams.caption: External beam/column intersection showing main top beam bars bent down into the column

elements_visible.top_beam_bars: horizontal bars bent down (L-shape) into lower column
elements_visible.column: vertical member at end of beam

key_rules_illustrated: L-bars cast into lower column before beam cage placed
Position of L-bars must be clearly shown on drawings
If reinforcement not in correct position, construction can be delayed
Reference to Model Detail MS2 for this configuration
